name: Head of Gath'Ilzogg
summary: In Redridge, Gath'Ilzogg's fall breaks the Blackrock leadership behind Stonewatch Keep's siege and brings Lakeshire desperate relief.

sections.title: A Bountied Warlord
sections.body:
Gath'Ilzogg led the Blackrock assault that seized Stonewatch Keep and drove out its defenders. From there, the valley suffered constant raids. Lakeshire stood near ruin, and Stormwind sent almost no military help. So Magistrate Solomon offered a bounty on the warlord.

Gath'Ilzogg fell in the keep's fortified upper levels. His death breaks the local Blackrock leadership. For Lakeshire, it is the first step toward reclaiming the keep for the kingdom.

faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg was a powerful Blackrock orc warlord. He led the conquest of Stonewatch Keep and directed raids against Redridge Mountains settlements, bringing Lakeshire close to collapse.

faq.q: Where is the head taken once collected?
faq.answer: You take the head to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire's town hall. It proves the bounty on the town's wanted board has been fulfilled.

faq.q: What does Gath'Ilzogg's death mean for Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg's death deprives the Blackrock invaders of their chief tactician in Redridge. Many Blackrock orcs remain entrenched across Stonewatch, but the break in their command gives the local defense a chance to hold the region.
Gath'Ilzogg occupied the high reaches of Stonewatch Keep, deep within the captured fortification. His personal bodyguards and lieutenants were with him.

angles.text: For Stormwind's people, bringing down Gath'Ilzogg avenges the slaughter of innocent settlers and the humiliating fall of Stonewatch Keep.
With the capital distracted by internal squabbles, Alliance volunteers must defend Redridge and strike down Blackrock leaders themselves.
